sn35.243:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
sn35.243:1.2: tena kho pana samayena kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ navaṃ santhāgāraṃ acirakāritaṃ hoti, anajjhāvutthaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūtena.
sn35.243:1.3: atha kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn35.243:1.4: idha bhante kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ navaṃ santhāgāraṃ acirakāritaṃ hoti, anajjhāvutthaṃ samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā kenaci vā manussabhūte,
sn35.243:1.6: bhagavatā paṭhamaṃ paribhuttaṃ pacchā kāpilavatthavā sakyā paribhuñjissanti;
sn35.243:1.7: tadassa kāpilavatthavānaṃ sakyānaṃ dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāyāti.
sn35.243:2.1: atha kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena navaṃ santhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā sabbasanthariṃ santhāgāraṃ santharāpetvā āsanāni paññāpetvā udakamaṇikaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā telappadīpaṃ āropetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn35.243:2.2: sabbasantharisanthataṃ bhante santhāgāraṃ, āsanāni paññattāni udakamaṇiko patiṭṭhāpito, telappadīpo āropito
sn35.243:2.4: atha kho bhagavā nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena navaṃ santhāgāraṃ tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā pāde pakkhāletvā santhāgāraṃ pavisitvā majjhimathambhaṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi.
sn35.243:2.5: bhikkhusaṅghopi kho pāde pakkhāletvā santhāgāraṃ pavisitvā pacchimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya puratthābhimukho nisīdi bhagavantaññeva purakkhatvā.
sn35.243:2.6: kāpilavatthavāpi kho sakyā pāde pakkhāletvā santhāgāraṃ pavisitvā puratthimaṃ bhittiṃ nissāya pacchimābhimukhā nisīdiṃsu bhagavantaññeva purakkhatvā.
sn35.243:2.7: atha kho bhagavā kāpilavatthave sakye bahudeva rattiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uyyojesi:
sn35.243:2.10: ‘evambhante’ti kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā bhagavato paṭissutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkamiṃsu.
sn35.243:3.1: atha kho bhagavā acirapakkantesu kāpilavatthevesu sakyesu āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ āmantesi:
sn35.243:3.3: paṭibhātu taṃ moggallāna, bhikkhūnaṃ dhammī kathā.
sn35.243:3.6: evambhanteti kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhagavato paccassosi.
sn35.243:3.7: atha kho bhagavā catugguṇaṃ saṅghāṭiṃ paññāpetvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappesi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya, sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasi karitvā.
sn35.243:3.8: tatra kho āyasmā mahāmoggallāno bhikkhū āmantesi
sn35.243:3.10: āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa paccassosuṃ.
sn35.243:4.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe adhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe byāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso,
sn35.243:4.3: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti. sotena saddaṃ sutvā …pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā …pe…
sn35.243:4.4: jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā …pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā …pe…
sn35.243:4.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme adhimuccati, appiya rūpe dhamme byāpajjati, anupaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati parittacetaso,
sn35.243:4.6: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti;
sn35.243:4.7: ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bhikkhu avassuto cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu avassuto sotaviññeyyesu saddesu, avassuto ghānaviññeyyesu gandhesu,
sn35.243:4.8: avassuto jivhāviññeyyesu rasesu, avassuto kāyaviññeyyesu phoṭṭhabbesu,
sn35.243:4.10: evaṃ vihāriṃ cāvuso bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati, labhateva māro otāraṃ labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ; sotato cepi naṃ …pe… ghānato cepi naṃ …pe…
sn35.243:4.11: jivhāto cepi naṃ …pe… kāyato cepi naṃ …pe…
sn35.243:4.12: manato cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati, labhateva māro otāraṃ labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
sn35.243:5.1: seyyathāpi āvuso naḷāgāraṃ vā tiṇāgāraṃ vā sukkhaṃ kolāpaṃ terovassikaṃ
sn35.243:5.2: puratthimāya cepi naṃ disāya puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya; labhetheva aggi otāraṃ, labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ.
sn35.243:5.3: pacchimāya cepi naṃ disāya puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya …pe…
sn35.243:5.8: yato kuto cepi naṃ puriso, ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya; labhetheva aggi otāraṃ, labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ.
sn35.243:5.9: evameva kho āvuso evaṃ vihāriṃ bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati; labhateva māro otāraṃ, labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ. sotato cepi naṃ …pe… ghānato cepi naṃ …pe…
sn35.243:5.10: jivhāto cepi naṃ …pe… kāyato cepi naṃ …pe…
sn35.243:5.11: manato cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati labhateva māro otāraṃ, labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
sn35.243:5.12: evaṃ vihāriṃ cāvuso bhikkhuṃ rūpā adhibhaṃsu, na bhikkhu rūpe adhibhosi;
sn35.243:5.13: saddā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu, na bhikkhu sadde adhibhosi;
sn35.243:5.14: gandhā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu, na bhikkhuṃ gandhe adhibhosi;
sn35.243:5.15: rasā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu, na bhikkhu rase adhibhosi;
sn35.243:5.16: phoṭṭhabbā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu, na bhikkhu phoṭṭhabbe adhibhosi;
sn35.243:5.17: dhammā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu, na bhikkhu dhamme adhibhosi;
sn35.243:5.18: ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bhikkhu rūpādhibhūto saddādhibhūto gandhādhibhūto rasādhibhūto phoṭṭhabbādhibhūto dhammādhibhūto, adhibhūto anadhibhū adhibhaṃsu naṃ pāpakā akusalā dhammā saṅkilesikā ponobhavikā sadarā dukkhavipākā āyatiṃ jāti jarāmaraṇiyā.
sn35.243:6.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā piyarūpe rūpe nādhimuccati, appiyarūpe rūpe na vyāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇacetaso,
sn35.243:6.3: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti; sotena saddaṃ sutvā …pe… ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā …pe…
sn35.243:6.4: jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā …pe… kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā …pe…
sn35.243:6.5: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya piyarūpe dhamme nādhimuccati, appiyarūpe dhamme na vyāpajjati, upaṭṭhitakāyasati ca viharati appamāṇa cetaso,
sn35.243:6.6: tañca cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti yatthassa te uppannā pāpakā akusalā dhammā aparisesā nirujjhanti.
sn35.243:6.7: ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bhikkhu anavassuto cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu …pe…
sn35.243:6.8: anavassuto jivhāviññeyyesu rasesu …pe… anavassuto manoviññeyyesu dhammesu.
sn35.243:6.9: evaṃ vihāriṃ cāvuso bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati, neva labhati māro otāraṃ, na labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ; sotato cepi naṃ …pe… ghānato cepi naṃ …pe…
sn35.243:6.10: jivhāto cepi naṃ …pe… kāyato cepi naṃ …pe…
sn35.243:6.11: manato cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati, neva labhati māro otāraṃ, na labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
sn35.243:7.1: seyyathāpi āvuso, kūṭāgārakā vā kūṭāgārasālā vā bahalamattikā addāvalimpanā.
sn35.243:7.2: puratthimāya cepi naṃ disāya puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya, neva labhetha aggi otāraṃ na labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ;
sn35.243:7.8: yato kuto cepi naṃ puriso ādittāya tiṇukkāya upasaṅkameyya, neva labhetha aggi otāraṃ, na labhetha aggi ārammaṇaṃ.
sn35.243:7.9: evameva kho āvuso, evaṃ vihāriṃ bhikkhuṃ cakkhuto cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati, neva labhati māro otāraṃ, na labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ …pe…
sn35.243:7.10: manato cepi naṃ māro upasaṅkamati neva labhati māro otāraṃ na labhati māro ārammaṇaṃ.
sn35.243:7.11: evaṃ vihārī cāvuso bhikkhu rūpe adhibhosi, na rūpā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu;
sn35.243:7.12: sadde bhikkhu adhibhosi, na saddā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu;
sn35.243:7.13: gandhe bhikkhu adhibhosi, na gandhā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu;
sn35.243:7.14: rase bhikkhu adhibhosi, na rasā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu;
sn35.243:7.15: phoṭṭhabbe bhikkhu adhibhosi, na phoṭṭhabbā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu;
sn35.243:7.16: dhamme bhikkhu adhibhosi, na dhammā bhikkhuṃ adhibhaṃsu;
sn35.243:7.17: ayaṃ vuccatāvuso bhikkhu rūpādhibhū saddādhibhū gandhādhibhū rasādhibhū phoṭṭhabbādhibhū dhammādhibhū; adhibhū, anadhibhūto adhibhosi te pāpake akusale dhamme saṃkilesike ponobhavike sadare dukkhavipāke āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇike.
sn35.243:8.1: atha kho bhagavā vuṭṭhahitvā āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ āmantesi:
sn35.243:8.3: sādhu kho tvaṃ moggallāna bhikkhūnaṃ avassutapariyāyañca anavassutapariyāyañca abhāsīti.
sn35.243:9.3: attamanā te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandiṃsūti.
